package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

func diagnosticRepoTestAttempt() domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt {
	return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{
		Schema: "student-diagnostic-assessment-attempt.v1", ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", PlanID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		CourseID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", PlanRevision: 1, PolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPolicy,
		OnboardingVersion: 1, BootstrapPolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticBootstrapPolicy,
		BootstrapContextDigest: "sha256:cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc",
		CourseContentRevision:  "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
		PlanDigest:             "sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb",
		CreatedAt:              time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 123000000, time.UTC), SubmittedItems: 2,
		Items: []domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanItem{{LessonID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", TaskID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", TaskVersion: 1, UpdatedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), LearningTargets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.syntax", Version: "v1"}}}},
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticReservationAndCurrentQueryBindAuthoritativeOnboarding(t *testing.T) {
	payload, err := os.ReadFile("diagnostic_assessment_repo_pg.go")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	source := string(payload)
	for _, required := range []string{
		"SELECT version FROM student_onboarding WHERE student_id=$1 FOR SHARE",
		"onboardingVersion != plan.OnboardingVersion",
		"JOIN student_onboarding onboarding ON onboarding.student_id=attempt.student_id",
		"attempt.onboarding_version=onboarding.version",
		"ORDER BY attempt.plan_revision DESC, attempt.reserved_at DESC, attempt.id DESC",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(source, required) {
			t.Fatalf("missing onboarding freshness guard %q", required)
		}
	}
}

func TestValidHistoricalDiagnosticAttemptBindsImmutableSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	current := diagnosticRepoTestAttempt()
	current.SubmittedItems = 1
	snapshot := current
	if !validHistoricalDiagnosticAttempt(snapshot, current, "SUBMIT") {
		t.Fatal("valid submit replay rejected")
	}
	for name, mutate := range map[string]func(*domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt){
		"created at":       func(a *domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt) { a.CreatedAt = a.CreatedAt.Add(time.Second) },
		"student":          func(a *domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt) { a.StudentID = current.CourseID },
		"onboarding":       func(a *domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt) { a.OnboardingVersion++ },
		"bootstrap policy": func(a *domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt) { a.BootstrapPolicyVersion = "other" },
		"bootstrap digest": func(a *domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt) {
			a.BootstrapContextDigest = "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("d", 64)
		},
		"items": func(a *domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt) { a.Items[0].TaskVersion++ },
		"result": func(a *domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt) {
			a.Result = &domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult{Schema: "student-diagnostic-assessment-result.v1"}
		},
		"zero submit count":     func(a *domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt) { a.SubmittedItems = 0 },
		"too many submit count": func(a *domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt) { a.SubmittedItems = len(a.Items) + 1 },
	} {
		candidate := snapshot
		candidate.Items = append([]domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanItem(nil), snapshot.Items...)
		for i := range candidate.Items {
			candidate.Items[i].LearningTargets = append([]domain.LearningTargetRef(nil), snapshot.Items[i].LearningTargets...)
		}
		mutate(&candidate)
		if validHistoricalDiagnosticAttempt(candidate, current, "SUBMIT") {
			t.Errorf("%s snapshot accepted", name)
		}
	}
	// A receipt captured after an earlier submit remains replayable after later
	// submissions, but cannot claim more than the authoritative current count.
	current.SubmittedItems = 2
	snapshot.SubmittedItems = 1
	if !validHistoricalDiagnosticAttempt(snapshot, current, "SUBMIT") {
		t.Fatal("historical lower submit count rejected")
	}
}

func TestValidHistoricalDiagnosticAttemptSeparatesReserveAndSubmit(t *testing.T) {
	current := diagnosticRepoTestAttempt()
	current.SubmittedItems = 0
	snapshot := current
	if !validHistoricalDiagnosticAttempt(snapshot, current, "RESERVE") {
		t.Fatal("valid reserve replay rejected")
	}
	if validHistoricalDiagnosticAttempt(snapshot, current, "SUBMIT") {
		t.Fatal("reserve snapshot accepted as submit replay")
	}
	snapshot.SubmittedItems = 1
	if validHistoricalDiagnosticAttempt(snapshot, current, "RESERVE") {
		t.Fatal("reserve snapshot with submissions accepted")
	}
	if validHistoricalDiagnosticAttempt(snapshot, current, "UNKNOWN") {
		t.Fatal("unknown command kind accepted")
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticReceiptResultMustMatchAuthoritativeResult(t *testing.T) {
	authoritative := domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult{Schema: "student-diagnostic-assessment-result.v1", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", CourseID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", CourseContentRevision: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64), PolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPolicy, AttemptID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", PlanID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", PlanRevision: 1, Correct: 3, Total: 3, Percent: 100, Band: "ADVANCED", BandPolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentBandPolicy, PlanDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64), CompletedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}
	authoritative.ResultDigest, _ = domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResultDigest(authoritative)
	if !diagnosticResultsEqual(authoritative, authoritative) {
		t.Fatal("identical result mismatch")
	}
	altered := authoritative
	altered.Correct = 2
	altered.Percent = 66
	altered.Band = "CORE"
	altered.ResultDigest, _ = domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResultDigest(altered)
	if diagnosticResultsEqual(altered, authoritative) {
		t.Fatal("self-consistent altered receipt accepted")
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticAttemptReservationTimestampIsMicrosecondCanonical(t *testing.T) {
	plan := domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{
		Schema: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanSchema, ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", CourseID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		PlanRevision: 1, PolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPolicy,
		OnboardingVersion: 1, BootstrapPolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticBootstrapPolicy,
		BootstrapContextDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("c", 64),
		CourseContentRevision:  "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64), PlanDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64),
		CreatedAt:   time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
		Assessments: []domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanItem{{LessonID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", TaskID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", TaskVersion: 1, UpdatedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), LearningTargets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.syntax", Version: "v1"}}}},
	}
	created := time.Date(2026, 1, 3, 0, 0, 0, 123456789, time.UTC)
	attempt := diagnosticAttemptFromPlan(plan.ID, plan, created)
	if !attempt.CreatedAt.Equal(created.UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)) || attempt.CreatedAt.Nanosecond()%1000 != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("reservation timestamp was not canonical: %s", attempt.CreatedAt)
	}
	if !validHistoricalDiagnosticAttempt(attempt, attempt, "RESERVE") {
		t.Fatal("canonical reservation snapshot rejected as historical replay")
	}
}

func TestStoredDiagnosticResultCanonicalizesZeroOffsetLocationBeforeValidation(t *testing.T) {
	result := domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult{
		Schema: "student-diagnostic-assessment-result.v1", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		CourseID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", CourseContentRevision: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64),
		PolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPolicy, AttemptID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		PlanID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", PlanRevision: 1, Correct: 3, Total: 3, Percent: 100,
		Band: "ADVANCED", BandPolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentBandPolicy,
		PlanDigest:  "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64),
		CompletedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 123456000, time.UTC),
	}
	result.ResultDigest, _ = domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResultDigest(result)
	result.CompletedAt = result.CompletedAt.In(time.FixedZone("database-utc", 0))

	normalized, err := normalizeStoredDiagnosticResult(result)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("normalize stored diagnostic result: %v", err)
	}
	if normalized.CompletedAt.Location() != time.UTC || !normalized.CompletedAt.Equal(result.CompletedAt) {
		t.Fatalf("stored timestamp was not canonicalized: %s (%s)", normalized.CompletedAt, normalized.CompletedAt.Location())
	}
}

func TestGetDiagnosticAssessmentRejectsNoncanonicalIDsBeforePoolAccess(t *testing.T) {
	repo := &DiagnosticAssessmentRepoPG{}
	for _, ids := range [][2]string{{" " + diagnosticRepoTestAttempt().StudentID, diagnosticRepoTestAttempt().ID}, {diagnosticRepoTestAttempt().StudentID, "{" + diagnosticRepoTestAttempt().ID + "}"}, {strings.ToUpper("abcdefab-abcd-4abc-8abc-abcdefabcdef"), diagnosticRepoTestAttempt().ID}} {
		if _, err := repo.GetDiagnosticAssessment(context.Background(), ids[0], ids[1]); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
			t.Fatalf("ids=%q/%q err=%v", ids[0], ids[1], err)
		}
	}
}
